grade.verdict_quote: ### 3. Verdict: **FAIL — needs work** ... Not ready to merge.

E1.quote: Actual: scrollWidth 420 > clientWidth 375; Checkout button's right edge at x=399 (24px past the viewport).
E1.evidence: node /tmp/evidence/layout.mjs → 'width=375: cart flex-direction=column scrollWidth=420 clientWidth=375 horizontalOverflow=true checkoutBox={"x":41,...,"width":358,...}' (tool log [18])

E2.quote: 768px breakpoint excludes 768px itself — cart.css media query is min-width: 769px. ... Actual: stacked (column) layout; measured flexDirection: column.
E2.evidence: node /tmp/evidence/layout.mjs → 'width=768: cart flex-direction=column scrollWidth=768 clientWidth=768 horizontalOverflow=false' (tool log [18])

E3.quote: Quantity can exceed 10 or drop to 0/negative ... Actual: qty becomes 11 before the button disables
E3.evidence: node /tmp/evidence/stepper.mjs → 'click 9: qty=10 inc.disabled=false' then 'click 10: qty=11 inc.disabled=true' (tool log [10])

E4.quote: Clicking `.dec` once at qty=1 (`dec.disabled=false`) drops qty to **0**.
E4.evidence: node /tmp/evidence/stepper2.mjs → 'before click 1: qty=1 dec.disabled=false' then 'after click 1: qty=0 dec.disabled=true' (tool log [11])

E5.quote: Discount doesn't follow later quantity changes ... Actual: discount stays at the original cents amount (log above: subtotal rose to $1182.00, discount frozen at −$105.30 instead of −$118.20).
E5.evidence: node /tmp/evidence/promo.mjs → 'Subtotal: $1182.00' / 'Discount text: −$105.30 (expected 10% of new subtotal = $118.20 if it follows)' (tool log [12])

E6.quote: Stale "Code not recognised" message isn't cleared by a valid code ... Actual: message stays visible even though the discount applied correctly.
E6.evidence: node /tmp/evidence/promo2.mjs → 'After SAVE10 -> text: "Code not recognised" hidden attr: null' / 'Is the error paragraph visible on screen? true' (tool log [13])

E7.quote: No thousands separator in money values ... Actual: $1053.00, everywhere an amount ≥ $1,000 is shown.

E8.quote: Empty-cart state doesn't hide the summary/Checkout ... Actual: summary card and enabled Checkout button remain fully visible with $0.00 totals.
E8.evidence: node /tmp/evidence/remove.mjs → '#summary computed display: block' / 'Checkout link visible (per computed style, ignoring class): true' plus grep no matches for is-hidden and Read of empty-state.png (tool log [15],[16],[17])

E9.quote: Quantity changes are never persisted ... Actual: `localStorage['cart:v1']` stays `null` after a qty change; reload reverts to the default quantity.
E9.evidence: node /tmp/evidence/persist2.mjs → 'localStorage["cart:v1"] right after clicking + on line 2 (qty now 2): null'; node /tmp/evidence/persist.mjs → reload shows 'MN-27 qty= 1' instead of 3 (tool log [22],[23])
